standards.applies_because: Design qualification of the PV modules (buy certified modules)
Safety qualification of the PV modules
Commissioning tests and documentation of the grid-connected system
Low-voltage electrical installation rules for PV systems
Grid connection of generating plants to the low-voltage network (EU)

risks.risk: Roof structure cannot take the added load or wind uplift
risks.mitigation: Structural check by the installer's engineer (Eurocode EN 1991), ballast/anchor design
Certified connectors from one maker, torque-checked, rapid shutdown / optimisers where required
Submit the network operator request at design freeze (Enedis / REE)

risks.risk: Shading from chimney, trees or neighbours
risks.mitigation: Site survey with a shade analysis; optimisers on shaded strings
Manufacturer-approved hooks and flashing, installer warranty on waterproofing

tests.name: Commissioning: continuity, polarity, Voc/Isc, insulation resistance
tests.method: Per string with a PV tester, report to the owner

tests.name: Thermal imaging of the array under load
Inverter grid-protection settings check
tests.method: Compare with the network operator's required settings

prototype.method: Pilot installation on one roof (site survey → permit → install → commissioning)
steps: Site survey: roof pitch, azimuth, shading, structure photos
Design: module layout, strings, inverter sizing; PVGIS yield check
Permits: planning declaration + grid connection request
Install (1-2 days): mounting, modules, DC/AC wiring, inverter
